title: Among users who placed bounties of 50 on posts whose titles mention 'varian
question: Among users who placed bounties of 50 on posts whose titles mention 'variance' and whose own reputation exceeds 1000, which user has the highest total view count across all their posts? Return the user's display name.

prediction.sql: SELECT T1."XCL_055" FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033" WHERE T2."XCL_030" = 50 AND T2."XCL_035" LIKE '%variance%' AND T1."XCL_053" > 1000 GROUP BY T1."XCL_052", T1."XCL_055" ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_030") DESC LIMIT 1

FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
WHERE T2."XCL_030" = 50
  AND T2."XCL_032" LIKE '%variance%'
  AND T1."XCL_053" > 1000
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052", T1."XCL_055"
ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_031") DESC
LIMIT 1
